args.lesson: Visibility is UNKNOWN_DEGRADED_RESULTS. I ran three Bing GETs (TASK-179431416111..113), all HTTP 200, with no challenge. The live catalogue offer appeared in none of them, but Bing ignored the query each time: the quoted hostname returned nypost and reddit, the quoted title returned colour sites, and the buyer-intent query returned only Shopify brand pages. These pages therefore cannot measure indexing. What worked: I decoded the result destinations out of Bing's ck/a redirects, which separated real hits from the 21 query echoes. What failed: neither DuckDuckGo (CAPTCHA, 2026-11-07) nor Bing (fallback results) can measure visibility through FETCH. Next time: do no more search-engine visibility probes unless we get a sanctioned search API or webmaster access. Exposure for this offer now depends on an authorized distribution step (operator batch item 4) or a classified feedback change.
